annotation.bound_parties_text: The Government, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, other ministers, and local governments are tasked with promoting the drone industry; entrusted institutions and exclusive drone traffic management business entities are bound by confidentiality rules.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No person who performs or performed the functions entrusted under this Act shall disclose to a third party confidential information acquired in the course of performing such functions.
annotation.dates_quote: This Act shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ACT ON PROMOTION OF UTILIZATION OF DRONES AND CREATION OF INFRASTRUCTURE THEREFOR Act No. 16420, Apr. 30, 2019
